# ProGrade Digital

> > ProGrade Digital manufactures professional memory cards including CFexpress and CFast formats, offering storage solutions, software tools, and educational content for photographers and filmmakers.

Founded by industry veterans including filmmaker Lukas Colombo, ProGrade Digital produces high-performance memory cards like the Iridium CFexpress Type B series, which have been tested by NASA for the Artemis mission. The company also provides Refresh Pro software and extensive educational resources on photography, videography, and storage technology.

## Key Topics

- CFexpress memory cards
- CFast 2.0 technology
- Iridium CFexpress Type B Cards
- Refresh Pro software
- NASA Artemis partnership
- Lukas Colombo (founder)
- Memory card technology
